correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and 0<=a<1, perpendicular (n-1)-ball slices give sigma_parallel^2=delta^2 B2/B0 and sigma_perp^2=sigma_parallel^2+a delta B1/B0 exactly; boundary-safe integration by parts proves the key cancellation. The logarithmic score of the size-biased s-law has derivative -2k/[1+a+(1-a)s]^2<0, so d(B2/B1)/da is a strictly negative covariance. Beta integration verifies both sharp endpoint constants, limits, and thin-lens rates. Direct fraction arithmetic in dimension three and 412 checked computations supplement, but do not replace, these infinite-quantifier proofs.

value.rationale: A natural shape-statistics invariant for the curvature-constrained extremal lens has a complete all-dimensional exact and sharp classification. The result identifies the unique separation parameter from covariance eccentricity, exact transverse–axial cancellation, sharp global scale-free bounds, and different thin-lens eigenvalue rates. This is a motivated structural statement beyond computing an arbitrary isolated moment; no claims are made for general convex bodies.
